dialogue.content: 本日どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. We'll begin now that it's our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: （こんにちは、こちらこそよろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Hello, thank you for having me.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まず初めに年齢・性別、今日の相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 30代女性、息子が不登校です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s, and my son is not attending school.

dialogue.content: 息子さんが不登校の状況なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see—your son is currently not attending school.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 今日のご相談は息子さんのお話になりますか？
dialogue.English: Will our discussion today be about your son?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's correct.

dialogue.content: お知らせいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: どうぞ、お話しやすいところから、お話しくださいね・
dialogue.English: Please, feel free to start wherever you're most comfortable.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: どうぞ（お聴きしています）
dialogue.English: Please, go ahead. (I'm listening.)

dialogue.content: 息子が不登校で悩んでます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling because my son isn't attending school.

dialogue.content: はい。（聴いています）
dialogue.English: I see. (I'm listening.)

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いのか悩んでます
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんの年齢を教えていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you please tell me your son's age?

dialogue.content: 12歳です
dialogue.English: He's 12 years old.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。不登校心配ですね。いつごろからなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. It must be very worrying that he's not going to school. When did this start?

dialogue.content: 1ヶ月前から
dialogue.English: About a month ago.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。なにか出来事等あったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Was there any particular incident that might have triggered this?

dialogue.content: わからなくて困ってます
dialogue.English: I don't know, and that's what's troubling me.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、息子さんはこの一か月どのように過ごしているのですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. How has your son been spending his time this past month?

dialogue.content: 部屋に引きこもり状態
dialogue.English: He's been shut in his room.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お母様もこの１か月、気が気ではないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. I can imagine you've been incredibly worried this past month.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I have.

dialogue.content: 息子さんはとお話し等はできているのでしょうか？お食事等どうされているのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you been able to speak with your son? And what about his meals?

dialogue.content: 話ができなく、食事は部屋の前に置いています
dialogue.English: We can't talk, and I leave his meals in front of his door.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it's been.

dialogue.content: 状況がわからないと、どうしていいかわからないお気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.English: When you don't know what's going on, it's natural to feel at a loss about what to do.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: お母様の心労お察しいたします。
dialogue.English: I can only imagine the stress you're under.

dialogue.content: 息子さんはどんな性格のお子さんだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What was your son's personality like?

dialogue.content: 真面目だと思います
dialogue.English: I think he's serious and conscientious.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。まじめなお子さんなんですね。１２歳というと中学生ですか？それとも小学生ですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so he's a serious boy. At 12, is he in junior high or elementary school?

dialogue.content: 中学1年になります
dialogue.English: He's in the first year of junior high.

dialogue.content: ではこの４月から新しい学校生活を送り始めていた、という理解でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, he just started at his new school this April, is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい、５月から不登校になりました
dialogue.English: Yes, he stopped going to school in May.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。ちなみに小学校時代はどのように過ごしていたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, how was he during his elementary school years?

dialogue.content: 普通に通ってました
dialogue.English: He attended school normally.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。お母様にとっても新しい学校生活が始まってすぐのことで戸惑ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be very confusing for you as well, for this to happen so soon after he started a new school.

dialogue.content: そうですね、戸惑います
dialogue.English: Yes, it is confusing.

dialogue.content: 中学生になってまだ２か月しか経っていませんが、中学校生活になってから、お母様からみて、何か変わったこととか、お感じになったことはありますか？
dialogue.English: It's only been about two months since he entered junior high. From your perspective, have you noticed any changes in him since then, anything that stood out?

dialogue.content: わからなくて、急に不登校になったので驚きました
dialogue.English: I don't know; I was just so surprised that he suddenly stopped going to school.

dialogue.content: どうしたらよいやら
dialogue.English: I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。新しい環境の中でのこと、お母様ご自身も戸惑われるのは無理もありません。
dialogue.English: I understand. Given the new environment, it's completely natural that you would feel bewildered as well.

dialogue.content: 中学校の先生とは何かお話になっていますか？
dialogue.English: Have you spoken with his teachers at the junior high school?

dialogue.content: 話しましたが、原因がわからなく、ひとまず焦らずという事で話が終わりました
dialogue.English: I did, but they didn't know the cause either, and the conversation ended with them saying we shouldn't rush things for now.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ひとまず焦らず様子をみましょうということなのですね
dialogue.English: So, the consensus was to wait and see without rushing things.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: お母様としては、それを聴いてどのように感じましたか？
dialogue.English: As his mother, how did you feel when you heard that?

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いのかと感じました
dialogue.English: I felt like I still didn't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…
dialogue.English: I can understand that...

dialogue.content: ちなみに、この不登校の最初は、息子さんから「学校休みたい」という申し出があったということですか？
dialogue.English: Just to clarify, when he first stopped going to school, did it start with him asking to stay home?

dialogue.content: 急に部屋から出てこなくて、学校は？と聴いて行かない行かないと言われ、部屋から出てこないんで
dialogue.English: No, he just suddenly wouldn't come out of his room. When I asked, "What about school?" he just said, "I'm not going, I'm not going," and hasn't come out since.

dialogue.content: 1ヶ月経ちました
dialogue.English: It's been a month now.

dialogue.content: で、ひきこもりですね
dialogue.English: So, he's become a shut-in.

dialogue.content: ええ‥そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: Oh... I see, so that's how it happened.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いかと思って
dialogue.English: I've been wondering what I should do.

dialogue.content: お子様は日中はどのように過ごしているのでしょうか。お部屋の中はなかなかわからないかと思うのですが・・・。パソコンをしているとか何か、お気づきのことがあれば教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: How does your son spend his days? I imagine it's difficult to know what's going on in his room, but if you've noticed anything—for example, if he seems to be using a computer—could you please tell me?

dialogue.content: 部屋には鍵があり、中も見られず
dialogue.English: There's a lock on his door, so I can't see inside.

dialogue.content: わからなくて
dialogue.English: I really don't know.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お風呂等は入っていますか？トイレの時は外に出てくるという感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: Is he bathing? Does he come out to use the restroom?

dialogue.content: はい、夜中にお風呂は、入ってる形跡があり、私たちとも話がしたくないみたいです
dialogue.English: Yes, there are signs that he bathes late at night, and it seems he doesn't want to talk to us at all.

dialogue.content: 黙って部屋に入ろうかとも思いましたが、ダメで、たまにすれ違っても口を聞いてくれなくて
dialogue.English: I even thought about quietly going into his room, but I couldn't. Even when we occasionally pass each other, he won't speak to me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・。よかったら家族構成を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see... If you don't mind, could you tell me about your family composition?

dialogue.content: 夫と３人暮らしです
dialogue.English: The three of us live together: my husband, our son, and me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 黙ってへやにはいろうとしたらダメだったというのはどういった状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What did you mean when you said you tried to enter his room quietly, but it didn't work?

dialogue.content: お風呂に入ってる隙に部屋に入ろうと思いましたが、鍵がかかっていてダメでした
dialogue.English: I tried to go in while he was in the bath, but the door was locked, so I couldn't.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お母様としても少しでも様子がわかればと動こうとされていたのですね。
dialogue.English: So you were trying to take action, just to get even a small sense of how he was doing.

dialogue.content: そうですね、でも何もわからない
dialogue.English: Yes, but I still don't know anything.

dialogue.content: どうしようもなくて
dialogue.English: I feel completely helpless.

dialogue.content: 部屋の前に置いている食事は食べているのですか？
dialogue.English: Is he eating the meals you leave in front of his door?

dialogue.content: 食べてます、元気ではあると思います。部屋の中のことは一切わかりません
dialogue.English: He's eating them, so I think he's physically healthy. But I have no idea what's going on inside his room.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お母様はお仕事等されているのでしょうか？日中は息子さんは一人で家でいる状況だったりしますか？あと夫さんはどのようにこの状況をとらえているのでしょうか（質問ばかりですいません）
dialogue.English: I see. Are you currently working? Is your son at home alone during the day? Also, how does your husband view this situation? (I apologize for all the questions.)

dialogue.content: 仕事は、パートをしてますので、息子が1人になることもあります
dialogue.English: I work part-time, so there are times when my son is home alone.

dialogue.content: 夫は、焦らずにと言われましたが、子育てにあまり昔から興味なく、仕事も忙しいようで諦めてます
dialogue.English: My husband tells me not to rush things, but he's never been very interested in child-rearing, and he seems busy with work, so I've given up on him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。あなたに負担が大きくかかっているのですね。今回の不登校の件は今のところ学校にご相談という形でしょうか？ほかにも相談されていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like a heavy burden is falling on you. Regarding his not attending school, have you only consulted with the school so far? Have you spoken with anyone else?

dialogue.content: 学校だけです
dialogue.English: Only the school.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。人は自分の心を守るために、他との接触を断つことを選択するときもあります。なので見守ることも大切ですが、様子がわからないと周囲の心配も募りますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Sometimes people choose to cut off contact with others to protect themselves. So while it's important to watch over him, it's also natural for those around him to grow more worried when they don't know what's happening.

dialogue.content: そうですね、心配です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm worried.

dialogue.content: そして。お母様が一人で抱え込んでしまうことも心配しています。
dialogue.English: And I'm also concerned about you shouldering this all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 地域自治体にはひきこもりの相談窓口があったり、居場所を作っているところもあります。もしよかったら情報を収集していくのも一つかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Your local municipality may have support centers for social withdrawal or places that provide a safe space. If you're interested, gathering some information about those could be one option.

dialogue.content: そして、周囲がチームを組んで支援体制を作っていくことも大事だと考えています。引き続き学校とも連携をとってくださいね。
dialogue.English: I also believe it's important for the people around him to form a team and create a support system. Please continue to coordinate with the school as well.

dialogue.content: はい、息子と話ができないので、どのように対応すれば良いのか
dialogue.English: Okay, but since I can't talk to my son, I don't know how to handle this.

dialogue.content: 夫さんの理解が欲しいところですが、そこに対しての不満等はどうぞ、ここの相談窓口で吐き出してほしいと思います。
dialogue.English: It would be ideal to have your husband's understanding, but please feel free to vent any frustrations you have about that here at this counseling service.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは、昔からなんで諦めてます
dialogue.English: My husband has always been this way, so I've given up on him.

dialogue.content: 夫さんや、学校の対応に対して思っていることありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any thoughts or feelings about how your husband or the school is responding?

dialogue.content: 昔からなんですね・・・これまできっとご苦労があったのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: He's always been that way... I'm sure you must have gone through a lot over the years.

dialogue.content: どうにか息子に関わって欲しいけど、どうにも腰が重いので諦めてます
dialogue.English: I want him to get involved with our son somehow, but he's so reluctant to act that I've given up.

dialogue.content: 腰が重いもは夫さんですか？学校ですか？
dialogue.English: When you say 'reluctant to act,' are you referring to your husband, the school, or both?

dialogue.content: 学校は、結局息子1人に力注げないので仕方ないかなとか原因わからないからどうにも
dialogue.English: With the school, I feel like they can't pour all their energy into just one student, so it can't be helped. And since they don't know the cause, there's nothing they can do.

dialogue.content: 両方とも
dialogue.English: Both.

dialogue.content: なるほど。やりきれない思いになりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be incredibly frustrating.

dialogue.content: そんな思いを抱えながらここに来ましたが、やはり難しいですね
dialogue.English: I came here with all these feelings, but I see it's still a difficult situation.

dialogue.content: 毎日食事を届けるお母様の行動、とても尊いと思います。
dialogue.English: The act of you bringing him his meals every day is, I think, a very precious and admirable thing.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいでしょうかね？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 息子さんの友人関係であるとか・・・中学に入ってからのこととか（勉強のことや部活動とか）次回ご相談をお受けする際にお聞きできればと思っております。
dialogue.English: Next time we speak, I'd like to ask about your son's friendships and things since he started junior high—like his studies or club activities.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 何かに日常生活で変化が付けられること、一緒に考えていきましょう。お母様と一緒に息子さんを支えるチームとなって考えていきたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Let's think together about what changes we might be able to make in his daily life. I want to be part of a team with you to support your son.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: いえこちらこそ。
dialogue.English: No, thank you as well.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: 朝・昼・夕と食事を届けているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you bringing him meals for breakfast, lunch, and dinner?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこにはお母様の思いが詰まっているのですよね。またお話しできればと思います。本日は相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I'm sure each of those meals is filled with your feelings for him. I hope we can speak again. Thank you for coming in for counseling today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日は状況をお伺いするだけになりましたが、私たちはお母様のことを応援しております。それでは、終了とさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Today was mostly about understanding your situation, but please know that we are here to support you. We will conclude the session for today.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （クライエント役さん　本日はありがとうございました。今後の私の成長のために、評価をお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (To the person playing the client role: Thank you for your time today. For my future growth, I would appreciate your evaluation.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。こちらこそありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your efforts. Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: （それでは終了しますね　ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Then I'll end the session now. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
